## Notes

Expressive TTS with inline audio tags ([whispers], [sighs], [excited]), a Text to Dialogue endpoint for multi-speaker turns and interruptions, 70+ languages. Not recommended for real-time or conversational use at launch (latency, reliability); v2.5 Turbo or Flash recommended for real time.
